Ajinkya Rahane speaks on Test cricket, senior player respect post-retirement

Following his retirement from international cricket, Ajinkya Rahane has made several statements regarding the sport. He cautioned young player Vaibhav Suryavanshi about the difference between IPL and international cricket, stating it's easier in the former. Rahane also emphasized the need to respect senior cricketers, suggesting that not all is well within the team. He also commented on Test cricket's character and named Sachin Tendulkar as India's greatest batsman, not MS Dhoni or Virat Kohli.
